title: SafeGuard Fraud Intelligence Knowledge Base
purpose: A linked, queryable representation of the Ghana taxonomy and case dataset. This is a structured JSON knowledge bundle, not yet a vector database or trained model.

matching_policy.rule: Only match a pattern when its required indicators are supported by conversation evidence.
matching_policy.semantic: Semantic similarity retrieves candidate cases; similarity alone must never be treated as proof.
matching_policy.llm: An LLM may interpret ambiguous context but must return cited evidence spans and uncertainty.
matching_policy.risk: Risk is an evidence-based assessment, not a simple count of keyword hits.
matching_policy.entity_safety: Do not blacklist or label a phone number, person, wallet or organisation as fraudulent based on a single unverified report.
matching_policy.unresolved_case_policy: GH16 is retained for audit and uncertainty handling but excluded from positive fraud-pattern training examples.

fraud_patterns.name: Credential harvesting under service or verification pretext
Prompt misattribution during a real transaction
Physical cash or bundle substitution in agent workflow
Wallet enrolment or cross-device access deception

case_evidence_records.summary: A message claims a wallet credit arrived; a caller asks the customer to return it as a refund although the original credit is not established.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Bank of Ghana fraud report; aggregate pattern, not one named victim.

case_evidence_records.summary: Callers claim mistaken transfers and ask the target to help reverse them; five suspects were reportedly convicted.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Ghana News Agency reports convictions and recovery; exact prompts and credential requests not published.

case_evidence_records.summary: After a claimed mistaken transfer is rejected, a purported blocking message and an apparent official helper lead to guided wallet procedures.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: ModernGhana reproducing Graphic reporting; historical provider naming retained.

case_evidence_records.summary: A fake promotional SMS and caller posing as telecom staff direct a customer to an agent; the agent is induced to transfer funds under a different understanding of the transaction.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Ghana Police warning reported by GNA; multi-party pattern, not a single verified victim dossier.

case_evidence_records.summary: A locally known customer obtains repeated agent transfers by promising that a relative will bring cash to settle them.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Graphic Online/GNA court reporting; no technical platform breach described.

case_evidence_records.summary: A suspect allegedly copies a business owner's WhatsApp profile image and directs a vendor to transfer funds to another wallet.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Ghanaian Times citing Citi News; copied profile is not described as takeover of the owner's real account.

case_evidence_records.summary: Callers claiming to be MTN trainers guide an agent through wallet activity; the agent wallet is reportedly debited.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: GIABA institutional typology summary; exact commands and transcript unavailable.

case_evidence_records.summary: A caller claiming to be a senior officer offers reversal instruction; an employee enters a PIN and follows guidance before a large wallet transfer.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: GIABA typology; exact prompts and final judgment not fully supplied.

case_evidence_records.summary: A supposed prize or promotion leads a target through USSD steps and a debit prompt presented as necessary to receive the prize.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: GNA feature by fraud examiner; published expert description of a pattern.

case_evidence_records.summary: A caller uses contextual knowledge of an expected payment and supplies a different wallet destination; the intended recipient later contacts the payer.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Investigative reporting with victim accounts; recipient identity was assumed, not independently verified.

case_evidence_records.summary: An airtime-related favour is used to obtain or expose a wallet PIN; details in the library are limited.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Retained prior-edition dossier; limited source summary. Do not infer the exact technical use of the PIN.

case_evidence_records.summary: A customer seeking a cash withdrawal hands an agent a phone; a remote caller coaches the agent through prompts and a merchant-wallet transfer occurs instead of the expected cash-out.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Adom Online and MyJoyOnline court reporting; details differ across reports and disputed details are excluded.

case_evidence_records.summary: A caller claims a mistaken transfer and an apparent telecom message supports the claim; the target reports checking and rejecting it.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: MyJoyOnline report of a public account; amount and exact checking method not disclosed.

case_evidence_records.summary: A media-described scenario alleges that a separate request initiator causes a prompt during a real cash-out visit, leading the customer to approve the wrong operation.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Pulse Ghana article; no provider logs, identified investigation or independently verified collusion supplied.

case_evidence_records.summary: Fake business listings divert customers to forms requesting phone, network, amount and MoMo PIN under payment verification.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Cyber Security Authority advisory; aggregate category amount, not a PIN-harvesting-only total.

case_evidence_records.summary: A customer reports approving a withdrawal prompt showing a different service name and later disputing whether the outlet received the funds; the mechanism remains unresolved.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Daily Guide report; no verified social engineering, collusion or provider failure. Excluded from confirmed pattern training labels.

case_evidence_records.summary: A person seeking subscription support is reportedly redirected to links and hurried wallet-code entry; wallet loss and borrowing are alleged.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Graphic Online account; public personal account, no transaction logs or independent adjudication retrieved.

case_evidence_records.summary: Provider says a customer disclosed app-registration OTP, MoMo PIN and login OTP; provider attributes unauthorised transactions to wallet registration on another device.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: MobileMoney Ltd statement republished by MyJoyOnline; provider account, pretext and psychological tactic not established.

case_evidence_records.summary: A community poster says repeated calls were followed by a supposed MTN helper offering to stop them; the poster reports wallet loss after following a process.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Reddit r/ghana first-person account; comments are not corroboration.

case_evidence_records.summary: A commenter says an apparent food-order process shifted into a request for a wallet PIN; the commenter says they refused.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: Surviving Reddit comment beneath deleted original post; channel and provider response uncertain.

case_evidence_records.summary: A family account says a caller described an anonymous food delivery and requested a code as identity confirmation; the code was reportedly shared and funds were lost.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: MyNewsGH family account and embedded Instagram video; video not independently reviewed.

case_evidence_records.summary: An agent-association account describes a returned cash bundle whose denominations were allegedly substituted after a transaction cancellation.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: MoMAG account reported by Citi Newsroom; no named victim, provider ledger or court outcome.

case_evidence_records.summary: A false public loan advertisement using a programme identity links to a form requesting personal details including a MoMo PIN; the programme disavows it.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: 24H+ Secretariat official warning; credential-harvesting campaign, not proof of completed takeover.

case_evidence_records.summary: A caller claiming to be an MTN call centre alleges a mistaken transfer and blocked wallet; the target challenges the story and no fraud-induced transfer is established.
case_evidence_records.source_summary: YEN.com.gh report of audio exchange; audio authenticity and completeness not independently established.

engine_output_contract.confidence: number between 0 and 1; calibrated later, not an LLM's unsupported feeling
provenance: message IDs, timestamps or user-submitted source references
